The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. The food sits in a cluster roughly 10 cm across and is small in quantity: a few slices of seared beef (steak), some rice grains, a bit of broccoli and a few garnish leaves.

I estimate about 4 pieces of beef at roughly 20-25 g each, so about 90 g of meat. Rice and broccoli add roughly 30 g, for a total of about 120 g.

Steak at about 200 kcal per 100 g gives around 190 kcal for the meat. Rice, broccoli and any sauce add roughly 50 kcal, so the total is about 240 kcal.
